job_title: AWS Serverless API + AngularJS SaaS Developer
job_description:
Adela Technologies is a fast-growing, cloud-focused managed service provider based out of the Washington DC metro area. We support clients in various industries, such as non-profit, energy, education, healthcare, and the federal government. Our work in these various industries allows us to provide customized support solutions for any organization.

We believe in challenging the status quo and encouraging creativity and innovation. We pride ourselves on our company culture and transparency. We believe every employee is equally valuable and vital to executing our company vision.

Our team has expertise building DevSecOps platforms that help simplify the integration efforts, automation, and security controls required for software teams to focus more on building software and less on infrastructure, security, and automation.

We need a developer to use an existing framework (AWS SaaS factory reference solution) to integrate with the following infrastructure APIs:
AWS EKS/ECS
Kubernetes
Prisma Cloud
Sonarqube
JFrog Artifactory
Rancher
OpenShift 4.X
and others…

We need someone with AWS serverless, AngularJS, and API integration, single-sign on and multi-tenant environment experience. Please provide a link to your public repo with example projects.

Examples of other SaaS factory/AWS SaaS framework deployments would be helpful.
Deliverables include:
Architecture Documentation
Regular Updates to Agile tasks/milestones
Source Code Commits to development and QA environment
Integrated Unit Tests for various API endpoints and functionality
